newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China Q1 trade surplus seen at $4.56 bln.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China Q1 trade surplus seen at $4.56 bln.

text.p: China is forecast to register a trade surplus of $4.56 billion in the first quarter of 1997, the China Business Daily said on Monday.
China posted a trade deficit of $10.96 billion in the first quarter of 1996, customs figures show.
Exports in the first three months of 1997 were expected to jump 11.3 percent to $31.45 billion from the year-earlier period, the newspaper said, quoting an unidentified government agency.
Imports were forecast to total $26.89 billion in the first quarter, down 9.4 percent compared with the same 1996 period, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
